question: What condition must hold for the act of applying meditation to this circle to be undertaken after worship?
premises: Worship of the circle must precede the application of meditation.
The application of meditation is limited to the duration indicated by yāvat.
The sequence links worship to a sustained meditative engagement with the circle.
inference: Meditation is applied to the circle only for as long as the prescribed condition holds after having worshipped it.
uncertainties: The precise temporal scope of yāvat remains context-dependent.
plain_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as the prescribed duration lasts.
